In the figure, A is connected to the midpoint of the right side BC, and A is also connected to the midpoint of the bottom side CD, and these two midpoints are also connected, forming a triangle. Reasoning: Let D=(0,0), C=(w,0), B=(w,h), A=(0,h), then the area of the rectangle wh=72. The midpoint of BC is M=(w,h/2), and the midpoint of CD is N=(w/2,0). The area of triangle AMN is 1/2 * |det(M-A, N-A)|. Among them, M-A=(w,-h/2), N-A=(w/2,-h), and the determinant is w*(-h)-(-h/2)*(w/2)=-wh+wh/4=-3wh/4, so the area is 1/2*(3wh/4)=3wh/8. If the rectangle has width w and height h, then ABM has area (1/2)·w·(h/2)=wh/4, MCN has area (1/2)·(w/2)·(h/2)=wh/8, and ADN has area (1/2)·h·(w/2)=wh/4.
